UP CM's 'Yogi Ki Paati' initiative completes 50 weeks

Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath's 'Yogi Ki Paati' initiative has completed 50 weeks. Described as a bridge of trust between the government and society, the initiative aims to strengthen direct dialogue, sensitivity, and trust between the Chief Minister and the public. The initiative reportedly incorporates government schemes alongside public aspirations, joys, sorrows, and suggestions. Jagatguru Satishacharya praised the initiative, stating that the 'Paati' (letter/message) provides reassurance.
